const makePublicId = (prefix: string) => `${prefix}-${nanoid(12).toUpperCase()}`;
function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.map(canonicalJson).join(",")}]`;
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
    return `{${Object.keys(record).sort().map((key) => `${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonicalJson(record[key])}`).join(",")}}`;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(value);
}

function getBenefit(quantity: number) {
  if (quantity >= 6) return { tier: "impulso", discount: 12, multiplier: 1.25 };
  if (quantity >= 3) return { tier: "constancia", discount: 6, multiplier: 1.1 };
  return { tier: "explora", discount: 0, multiplier: 1 };
}

async function resolveBenefit(quantity: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const promotions = await db.select().from(promotionRules).where(and(eq(promotionRules.kind, "volume_discount"), eq(promotionRules.isActive, true)));
  const candidates = promotions.map((promotion) => ({ promotion, conditions: JSON.parse(promotion.conditionsJson) as { minimum?: number; discount?: number; multiplier?: number } })).filter(({ conditions }) => quantity >= (conditions.minimum ?? 1));
  const selected = candidates.sort((left, right) => (right.conditions.minimum ?? 0) - (left.conditions.minimum ?? 0))[0];
  if (!selected) return getBenefit(quantity);
  return { tier: selected.promotion.code, discount: selected.conditions.discount ?? 0, multiplier: selected.conditions.multiplier ?? 1 };
}

function deterministicIndex(seed: string, context: string, size: number, counterStart = 0) {
  const max = 0x100000000;
  const limit = Math.floor(max / size) * size;
  let counter = counterStart;
  while (true) {
    const digest = createHmac("sha256", seed).update(`${context}:${counter}`).digest();
    const candidate = digest.readUInt32BE(0);
    if (candidate < limit) return { value: candidate % size, counter: counter + 1 };
    counter += 1;
  }
}

function sampleUnique(seed: string, context: string, range: number, count: number, startAt = 1) {
  const pool = Array.from({ length: range }, (_, index) => index + startAt);
  const values: number[] = [];
  let counter = 0;
  while (values.length < count) {
    const pick = deterministicIndex(seed, context, pool.length, counter);
    counter = pick.counter;
    values.push(pool.splice(pick.value, 1)[0]);
  }
  return values.sort((left, right) => left - right);
}

export function drawTrio13(seed: string, publicSeed: string, publicId: string) {
  return sampleUnique(seed, `${publicId}:${publicSeed}:${ALGORITHM_VERSION}`, 13, 3);
}

function calculateResult(gameType: GameType, seed: string, publicSeed: string, publicId: string) {
  const context = `${publicId}:${publicSeed}:${ALGORITHM_VERSION}`;
  if (gameType === "ruleta") {
    const number = deterministicIndex(seed, context, 37).value;
    const color = number === 0 ? "verde" : [1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 14, 16, 18, 19, 21, 23, 25, 27, 30, 32, 34, 36].includes(number) ? "rojo" : "negro";
    return { number, color };
  }
  if (gameType === "jackpot") return { positions: sampleUnique(seed, context, 20, 5) };
  if (gameType === "bingo") return { calls: sampleUnique(seed, context, 75, 15), winningCartilla: deterministicIndex(seed, `${context}:cartilla`, 3).value + 1 };
  if (gameType === "cartas") return { cards: drawTrio13(seed, publicSeed, publicId) };
  return { numbers: sampleUnique(seed, context, 49, 6) };
}

async function requireDatabase() {
  const db = await getDb();
  if (!db) throw new Error("La base de datos no está disponible.");
  return db;
}

async function appendAuditEvent(input: { actorUserId?: number; eventType: string; entityType: string; entityPublicId: string; payload: unknown }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const last = await db.select({ eventHash: auditEvents.eventHash }).from(auditEvents).orderBy(desc(auditEvents.id)).limit(1);
  const previousHash = last[0]?.eventHash ?? null;
  const payloadJson = canonicalJson(input.payload);
  const eventHash = sha256(`${previousHash ?? "genesis"}|${input.eventType}|${input.entityType}|${input.entityPublicId}|${payloadJson}`);
  await db.insert(auditEvents).values({
    publicId: makePublicId("AUD"),
    actorUserId: input.actorUserId,
    eventType: input.eventType,
    entityType: input.entityType,
    entityPublicId: input.entityPublicId,
    payloadJson,
    previousHash,
    eventHash,
  });
  return eventHash;
}

export async function bootstrapPilotRules(actorUserId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const now = new Date();
  const created: string[] = [];

  for (const gameType of GAME_TYPES) {
    const config = GAME_CONFIG[gameType];
    const existing = await db.select().from(gameRulesets).where(and(eq(gameRulesets.gameType, gameType), eq(gameRulesets.version, "v1.0.0"))).limit(1);
    let ruleset = existing[0];
    if (!ruleset) {
      await db.insert(gameRulesets).values({
        gameType,
        version: "v1.0.0",
        title: config.title,
        rulesJson: JSON.stringify({ gameType, pickLimit: config.pickLimit, numberRange: config.range, text: config.rules, pilotOnly: true }),
        prizePolicyJson: JSON.stringify({ text: config.prizes, virtualOnly: true, withdrawals: false }),
        isPublished: true,
        createdByUserId: actorUserId,
      });
      const rows = await db.select().from(gameRulesets).where(and(eq(gameRulesets.gameType, gameType), eq(gameRulesets.version, "v1.0.0"))).limit(1);
      ruleset = rows[0];
    }
    const openRound = await db.select().from(gameRounds).where(and(eq(gameRounds.gameType, gameType), inArray(gameRounds.state, ["draft", "open"]))).limit(1);
    if (!openRound[0] && ruleset) {
      const secret = randomBytes(32).toString("hex");
      const publicId = `RP-${gameType.slice(0, 1).toUpperCase()}-${nanoid(8).toUpperCase()}`;
      await db.insert(gameRounds).values({
        publicId,
        gameType,
        rulesetId: ruleset.id,
        state: "open",
        opensAt: now,
        closesAt: new Date(now.getTime() + 20 * 60 * 1000),
        serverSeedHash: sha256(secret),
        serverSeedSecret: secret,
        jackpotPoolCredits: gameType === "jackpot" ? 18400 : 0,
        algorithmVersion: ALGORITHM_VERSION,
        createdByUserId: actorUserId,
      });
      await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "round.opened", entityType: "round", entityPublicId: publicId, payload: { gameType, ruleset: ruleset.version, serverSeedHash: sha256(secret) } });
      created.push(publicId);
    }
  }
  const defaultMissions = [
    { code: "FIRST_TICKET", title: "Primer boleto", badgeLabel: "Inicio verificado", description: "Confirma una participación virtual.", targetCount: 1, rewardCredits: 80 },
    { code: "TWO_GAMES", title: "Explora dos modalidades", badgeLabel: "Explorador de mesa", description: "Participa en dos tipos de juego distintos.", targetCount: 2, rewardCredits: 120 },
    { code: "VERIFY_DRAW", title: "Consulta un sorteo", badgeLabel: "Verificador público", description: "Abre y confirma un expediente verificable.", targetCount: 1, rewardCredits: 60 },
  ];
  for (const mission of defaultMissions) {
    const existingMission = await db.select().from(missions).where(eq(missions.code, mission.code)).limit(1);
    if (!existingMission[0]) await db.insert(missions).values(mission);
  }
  const defaultPromotions = [
    { code: "explora", label: "Explora", conditions: { minimum: 1, discount: 0, multiplier: 1 } },
    { code: "constancia", label: "Constancia", conditions: { minimum: 3, discount: 6, multiplier: 1.1 } },
    { code: "impulso", label: "Impulso", conditions: { minimum: 6, discount: 12, multiplier: 1.25 } },
    { code: "racha_3", label: "Racha de tres", conditions: { every: 3, rewardCredits: 70 } },
  ];
  for (const promotion of defaultPromotions) {
    const existingPromotion = await db.select().from(promotionRules).where(eq(promotionRules.code, promotion.code)).limit(1);
    if (!existingPromotion[0]) await db.insert(promotionRules).values({ code: promotion.code, label: promotion.label, kind: promotion.code === "racha_3" ? "streak_bonus" : "volume_discount", conditionsJson: JSON.stringify(promotion.conditions), createdByUserId: actorUserId });
  }
  const socialCycle = await db.select().from(socialImpactCycles).where(eq(socialImpactCycles.periodLabel, "Piloto gratuito")).limit(1);
  if (!socialCycle[0]) {
    await db.insert(socialImpactCycles).values({
      publicId: makePublicId("SOC"),
      title: "Compromiso social del piloto",
      periodLabel: "Piloto gratuito",
      institutionalRateBps: 100,
      status: "pilot_disclosure",
      policyText: "Durante el piloto no hay dinero real ni utilidades. Si se habilita una versión regulada, se propondrá un aporte institucional de hasta 1 % de utilidades netas, divulgado por periodo y respaldado con un reporte. Las donaciones de ganadores serán siempre voluntarias, explícitas y no reducirán premios sin consentimiento.",
    });
  }
  return { created };
}

export async function getPublicRounds() {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const rows = await db.select().from(gameRounds).where(inArray(gameRounds.state, ["open", "locked", "drawn", "settled"])).orderBy(desc(gameRounds.createdAt));
  return rows.map(({ serverSeedSecret: _secret, ...round }) => round);
}

export async function getRoundProof(publicId: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const rows = await db.select().from(gameRounds).where(eq(gameRounds.publicId, publicId)).limit(1);
  const round = rows[0];
  if (!round) return null;
  const rulesetRows = await db.select().from(gameRulesets).where(eq(gameRulesets.id, round.rulesetId)).limit(1);
  const ruleset = rulesetRows[0];
  return {
    publicId: round.publicId,
    gameType: round.gameType,
    state: round.state,
    ruleset: ruleset ? { version: ruleset.version, rules: JSON.parse(ruleset.rulesJson), prizes: JSON.parse(ruleset.prizePolicyJson) } : null,
    serverSeedHash: round.serverSeedHash,
    revealedServerSeed: round.revealedServerSeed,
    publicSeed: round.publicSeed,
    ticketSetHash: round.ticketSetHash,
    result: round.resultJson ? JSON.parse(round.resultJson) : null,
    algorithmVersion: round.algorithmVersion,
    closesAt: round.closesAt,
    drawnAt: round.drawnAt,
  };
}

async function getOrCreateWallet(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const current = await db.select().from(virtualWallets).where(eq(virtualWallets.userId, userId)).limit(1);
  if (current[0]) return current[0];
  await db.insert(virtualWallets).values({ userId, balance: WELCOME_BONUS, welcomeBonusClaimed: true });
  const wallet = (await db.select().from(virtualWallets).where(eq(virtualWallets.userId, userId)).limit(1))[0];
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({
    publicId: makePublicId("WAL"),
    userId,
    type: "welcome_bonus",
    amount: WELCOME_BONUS,
    balanceAfter: WELCOME_BONUS,
    idempotencyKey: `welcome:${userId}`,
    description: "Bonificación de bienvenida del piloto",
    metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ pilotOnly: true }),
  });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "wallet.welcome_bonus", entityType: "wallet", entityPublicId: String(userId), payload: { amount: WELCOME_BONUS } });
  return wallet;
}

async function getOrCreatePlayerSettings(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const current = await db.select().from(playerSettings).where(eq(playerSettings.userId, userId)).limit(1);
  if (current[0]) return current[0];
  await db.insert(playerSettings).values({ userId, countryCode: "PE", sessionLimitMinutes: 60, marketingEnabled: false });
  return (await db.select().from(playerSettings).where(eq(playerSettings.userId, userId)).limit(1))[0];
}

async function setMissionProgress(userId: number, code: string, progressCount: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const mission = (await db.select().from(missions).where(eq(missions.code, code)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!mission) return;
  const existing = await db.select().from(playerMissionProgress).where(and(eq(playerMissionProgress.userId, userId), eq(playerMissionProgress.missionId, mission.id))).limit(1);
  const completedAt = progressCount >= mission.targetCount ? new Date() : null;
  if (existing[0]) {
    const nextProgress = Math.max(existing[0].progressCount, progressCount);
    await db.update(playerMissionProgress).set({ progressCount: nextProgress, completedAt: existing[0].completedAt ?? completedAt }).where(eq(playerMissionProgress.id, existing[0].id));
    return;
  }
  await db.insert(playerMissionProgress).values({ userId, missionId: mission.id, progressCount, completedAt });
}

async function updateTicketMissions(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const tickets = await db.select({ gameType: pilotTickets.gameType }).from(pilotTickets).where(and(eq(pilotTickets.userId, userId), eq(pilotTickets.status, "confirmed")));
  await setMissionProgress(userId, "FIRST_TICKET", tickets.length ? 1 : 0);
  await setMissionProgress(userId, "TWO_GAMES", Array.from(new Set(tickets.map((ticket) => ticket.gameType))).length);
}

async function awardStreakBonus(userId: number, ticketPublicId: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const streakRule = (await db.select().from(promotionRules).where(and(eq(promotionRules.code, "racha_3"), eq(promotionRules.isActive, true))).limit(1))[0];
  if (!streakRule) return 0;
  const conditions = JSON.parse(streakRule.conditionsJson) as { every?: number; rewardCredits?: number };
  const every = conditions.every ?? 3;
  const tickets = await db.select({ id: pilotTickets.id }).from(pilotTickets).where(eq(pilotTickets.userId, userId));
  if (!tickets.length || tickets.length % every !== 0) return 0;
  const reward = conditions.rewardCredits ?? 70;
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(userId);
  const nextBalance = wallet.balance + reward;
  await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId, type: "promotion_bonus", amount: reward, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `streak:${ticketPublicId}`, description: `Bono virtual ${streakRule.label}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ ticketPublicId, promotionCode: streakRule.code, pilotOnly: true }) });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "promotion.streak_awarded", entityType: "ticket", entityPublicId: ticketPublicId, payload: { reward, promotionCode: streakRule.code } });
  return reward;
}

export async function getMissionSummary(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const active = await db.select().from(missions).where(eq(missions.isActive, true));
  for (const mission of active) {
    const progress = await db.select().from(playerMissionProgress).where(and(eq(playerMissionProgress.userId, userId), eq(playerMissionProgress.missionId, mission.id))).limit(1);
    if (!progress[0]) await db.insert(playerMissionProgress).values({ userId, missionId: mission.id });
  }
  const progressRows = await db.select().from(playerMissionProgress).where(eq(playerMissionProgress.userId, userId));
  return active.map((mission) => ({ ...mission, progress: progressRows.find((progress) => progress.missionId === mission.id) }));
}

export async function claimMissionReward(userId: number, code: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const mission = (await db.select().from(missions).where(eq(missions.code, code)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!mission) throw new Error("No se encontró la misión.");
  const progress = (await db.select().from(playerMissionProgress).where(and(eq(playerMissionProgress.userId, userId), eq(playerMissionProgress.missionId, mission.id))).limit(1))[0];
  if (!progress || !progress.completedAt) throw new Error("La misión todavía no está completa.");
  if (progress.claimedAt) throw new Error("Esta recompensa ya fue reclamada.");
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(userId);
  const nextBalance = wallet.balance + mission.rewardCredits;
  await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
  await db.update(playerMissionProgress).set({ claimedAt: new Date() }).where(eq(playerMissionProgress.id, progress.id));
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId, type: "mission_reward", amount: mission.rewardCredits, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `mission:${userId}:${code}`, description: `Misión completada: ${mission.title}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ missionCode: code, pilotOnly: true }) });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "mission.claimed", entityType: "mission", entityPublicId: code, payload: { rewardCredits: mission.rewardCredits } });
  return { balance: nextBalance, reward: mission.rewardCredits, code };
}

export async function registerVerificationMission(userId: number) {
  await setMissionProgress(userId, "VERIFY_DRAW", 1);
  return getMissionSummary(userId);
}

export async function getWalletSummary(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(userId);
  const settings = await getOrCreatePlayerSettings(userId);
  const transactions = await db.select().from(walletTransactions).where(eq(walletTransactions.userId, userId)).orderBy(desc(walletTransactions.createdAt)).limit(20);
  const missionSummary = await getMissionSummary(userId);
  return { wallet, transactions, settings, missionSummary, pilotOnly: true, withdrawalsEnabled: false };
}

export async function getPublicMarkets() {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  return db.select().from(marketEvents).where(inArray(marketEvents.state, ["open", "closed", "settled", "voided"])).orderBy(desc(marketEvents.createdAt));
}

export async function getMarketSummary(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const [markets, positions] = await Promise.all([
    getPublicMarkets(),
    db.select().from(marketPositions).where(eq(marketPositions.userId, userId)).orderBy(desc(marketPositions.createdAt)),
  ]);
  return { markets, positions, pilotOnly: true, withdrawalsEnabled: false };
}

export function calculateMarketPayout(side: "yes" | "no", outcome: "yes" | "no", contracts: number, payoutCredits: number) {
  return side === outcome ? contracts * payoutCredits : 0;
}

export async function reserveMarketPosition(input: { userId: number; marketPublicId: string; side: "yes" | "no"; contracts: number; idempotencyKey: string }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.contracts) || input.contracts < 1 || input.contracts > 10) throw new Error("La cantidad de contratos virtuales debe estar entre 1 y 10.");
  const market = (await db.select().from(marketEvents).where(eq(marketEvents.publicId, input.marketPublicId)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!market || market.state !== "open" || new Date(market.closesAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) throw new Error("Este mercado virtual no está abierto.");
  const settings = await getOrCreatePlayerSettings(input.userId);
  if (settings.voluntaryPauseUntil && settings.voluntaryPauseUntil.getTime() > Date.now()) throw new Error("Tu pausa voluntaria está activa.");
  const existing = (await db.select().from(marketPositions).where(eq(marketPositions.idempotencyKey, input.idempotencyKey)).limit(1))[0];
  if (existing) return { publicId: existing.publicId, virtualCost: existing.virtualCost, side: existing.side, contracts: existing.contracts, recovered: true };
  const unitCostCredits = input.side === "yes" ? market.yesPriceCredits : market.noPriceCredits;
  const virtualCost = unitCostCredits * input.contracts;
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(input.userId);
  if (wallet.balance < virtualCost) throw new Error("No tienes créditos virtuales suficientes para esta posición.");
  const publicId = makePublicId("MKT");
  const nextBalance = wallet.balance - virtualCost;
  await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
  await db.insert(marketPositions).values({ publicId, userId: input.userId, marketId: market.id, side: input.side, contracts: input.contracts, unitCostCredits, virtualCost, idempotencyKey: input.idempotencyKey });
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId: input.userId, type: "market_debit", amount: -virtualCost, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `market:${input.idempotencyKey}`, description: `Posición virtual ${input.side.toUpperCase()} en ${market.publicId}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ marketPublicId: market.publicId, positionPublicId: publicId, pilotOnly: true }) });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: input.userId, eventType: "market.position_opened", entityType: "market", entityPublicId: market.publicId, payload: { positionPublicId: publicId, side: input.side, contracts: input.contracts, virtualCost } });
  return { publicId, virtualCost, side: input.side, contracts: input.contracts, balanceAfter: nextBalance, recovered: false };
}

export async function createCuratedMarket(actorUserId: number, input: { title: string; description: string; category: string; sourceLabel: string; sourceUrl: string; resolutionRule: string; yesPriceCredits: number; noPriceCredits: number; closesAt: Date }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  if (!isAllowedMarketCategory(input.category)) throw new Error("La categoría de MultiMarket no está permitida en el piloto.");
  if (input.closesAt.getTime() <= Date.now()) throw new Error("El cierre del mercado debe estar en el futuro.");
  const publicId = makePublicId("MKT");
  await db.insert(marketEvents).values({ ...input, publicId, state: "open", payoutCredits: 100, pilotOnly: true, createdByUserId: actorUserId });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "market.opened", entityType: "market", entityPublicId: publicId, payload: { ...input, pilotOnly: true } });
  return (await db.select().from(marketEvents).where(eq(marketEvents.publicId, publicId)).limit(1))[0];
}

export async function closeCuratedMarket(actorUserId: number, marketPublicId: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const market = (await db.select().from(marketEvents).where(eq(marketEvents.publicId, marketPublicId)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!market || market.state !== "open") throw new Error("El mercado no está disponible para cierre.");
  await db.update(marketEvents).set({ state: "closed", closesAt: new Date() }).where(eq(marketEvents.id, market.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "market.closed", entityType: "market", entityPublicId: market.publicId, payload: { closesAt: new Date().toISOString(), reason: "Cierre manual del operador" } });
  return { publicId: market.publicId, state: "closed" as const };
}

export async function resolveCuratedMarket(actorUserId: number, input: { marketPublicId: string; outcome: "yes" | "no"; resolutionUrl: string }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const market = (await db.select().from(marketEvents).where(eq(marketEvents.publicId, input.marketPublicId)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!market || !["open", "closed"].includes(market.state)) throw new Error("El mercado no está disponible para resolución.");
  const positions = await db.select().from(marketPositions).where(and(eq(marketPositions.marketId, market.id), eq(marketPositions.status, "active")));
  for (const position of positions) {
    const payout = calculateMarketPayout(position.side, input.outcome, position.contracts, market.payoutCredits);
    await db.update(marketPositions).set({ status: "settled", virtualPayout: payout, settledAt: new Date() }).where(eq(marketPositions.id, position.id));
    if (payout > 0) {
      const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(position.userId);
      const nextBalance = wallet.balance + payout;
      await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
      await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId: position.userId, type: "market_payout", amount: payout, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `market-payout:${position.publicId}`, description: `Liquidación virtual de ${market.publicId}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ marketPublicId: market.publicId, outcome: input.outcome, positionPublicId: position.publicId, pilotOnly: true }) });
    }
  }
  await db.update(marketEvents).set({ state: "settled", outcome: input.outcome, resolutionUrl: input.resolutionUrl, resolvesAt: new Date() }).where(eq(marketEvents.id, market.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "market.settled", entityType: "market", entityPublicId: market.publicId, payload: { outcome: input.outcome, resolutionUrl: input.resolutionUrl, positionCount: positions.length } });
  return { publicId: market.publicId, outcome: input.outcome, positionsSettled: positions.length };
}

export async function voidCuratedMarket(actorUserId: number, input: { marketPublicId: string; resolutionUrl: string }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const market = (await db.select().from(marketEvents).where(eq(marketEvents.publicId, input.marketPublicId)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!market || !["draft", "open", "closed"].includes(market.state)) throw new Error("El mercado no está disponible para anulación.");
  const positions = await db.select().from(marketPositions).where(and(eq(marketPositions.marketId, market.id), eq(marketPositions.status, "active")));
  for (const position of positions) {
    const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(position.userId);
    const nextBalance = wallet.balance + position.virtualCost;
    await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
    await db.update(marketPositions).set({ status: "refunded", virtualPayout: position.virtualCost, settledAt: new Date() }).where(eq(marketPositions.id, position.id));
    await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId: position.userId, type: "market_refund", amount: position.virtualCost, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `market-refund:${position.publicId}`, description: `Reembolso virtual por anulación de ${market.publicId}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ marketPublicId: market.publicId, positionPublicId: position.publicId, pilotOnly: true }) });
  }
  await db.update(marketEvents).set({ state: "voided", resolutionUrl: input.resolutionUrl, resolvesAt: new Date() }).where(eq(marketEvents.id, market.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "market.voided", entityType: "market", entityPublicId: market.publicId, payload: { resolutionUrl: input.resolutionUrl, positionsRefunded: positions.length } });
  return { publicId: market.publicId, positionsRefunded: positions.length };
}

export async function getSocialImpactSummary() {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  return db.select().from(socialImpactCycles).orderBy(desc(socialImpactCycles.createdAt));
}

export async function updateResponsibleSettings(userId: number, input: { sessionLimitMinutes: number; pauseHours: number; countryCode: string }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const settings = await getOrCreatePlayerSettings(userId);
  const voluntaryPauseUntil = input.pauseHours > 0 ? new Date(Date.now() + input.pauseHours * 60 * 60 * 1000) : null;
  await db.update(playerSettings).set({ sessionLimitMinutes: input.sessionLimitMinutes, countryCode: input.countryCode, voluntaryPauseUntil }).where(eq(playerSettings.id, settings.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "player_settings.updated", entityType: "player_settings", entityPublicId: String(userId), payload: { sessionLimitMinutes: input.sessionLimitMinutes, pauseHours: input.pauseHours, countryCode: input.countryCode } });
  return (await db.select().from(playerSettings).where(eq(playerSettings.id, settings.id)).limit(1))[0];
}

export async function claimDailyReward(userId: number) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(userId);
  const now = new Date();
  const lastClaim = wallet.lastDailyRewardAt?.getTime() ?? 0;
  if (lastClaim && now.getTime() - lastClaim < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) throw new Error("La recompensa diaria ya fue reclamada. Intenta nuevamente después de 24 horas.");
  const nextBalance = wallet.balance + DAILY_REWARD;
  await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance, lastDailyRewardAt: now }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({
    publicId: makePublicId("WAL"),
    userId,
    type: "daily_reward",
    amount: DAILY_REWARD,
    balanceAfter: nextBalance,
    idempotencyKey: `daily:${userId}:${now.toISOString().slice(0, 10)}`,
    description: "Recompensa diaria del piloto",
    metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ pilotOnly: true }),
  });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "wallet.daily_reward", entityType: "wallet", entityPublicId: String(userId), payload: { amount: DAILY_REWARD, balanceAfter: nextBalance } });
  return { balance: nextBalance, reward: DAILY_REWARD };
}

export async function reservePilotTicket(input: { userId: number; roundPublicId: string; picks: number[]; quantity: number; idempotencyKey: string }) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const roundRows = await db.select().from(gameRounds).where(eq(gameRounds.publicId, input.roundPublicId)).limit(1);
  const round = roundRows[0];
  if (!round || round.state !== "open") throw new Error("La ronda no está disponible para participar.");
  if (new Date(round.closesAt).getTime() <= Date.now()) throw new Error("La participación está cerrada para esta ronda.");
  const config = GAME_CONFIG[round.gameType];
  const settings = await getOrCreatePlayerSettings(input.userId);
  if (settings.voluntaryPauseUntil && settings.voluntaryPauseUntil.getTime() > Date.now()) throw new Error("Tu pausa voluntaria está activa. La participación se reanudará cuando finalice el periodo seleccionado.");
  const uniquePicks = Array.from(new Set(input.picks)).sort((left, right) => left - right);
  if (uniquePicks.length !== config.pickLimit || uniquePicks.some((value) => value < (round.gameType === "ruleta" ? 0 : 1) || value > config.range)) throw new Error("La selección no cumple las reglas de esta modalidad.");
  if (!Number.isInteger(input.quantity) || input.quantity < 1 || input.quantity > 10) throw new Error("La cantidad de boletos debe estar entre 1 y 10.");
  const existingDebit = await db.select().from(walletTransactions).where(eq(walletTransactions.idempotencyKey, `ticket:${input.idempotencyKey}`)).limit(1);
  if (existingDebit[0]) {
    const metadata = existingDebit[0].metadataJson ? JSON.parse(existingDebit[0].metadataJson) as { ticketPublicId?: string; ticketHash?: string; benefit?: ReturnType<typeof getBenefit> } : {};
    return {
      publicId: metadata.ticketPublicId ?? "TKT-RECUPERADO",
      virtualCost: Math.abs(existingDebit[0].amount),
      balanceAfter: existingDebit[0].balanceAfter,
      ticketHash: metadata.ticketHash ?? "",
      benefit: metadata.benefit ?? getBenefit(input.quantity),
    };
  }
  const benefit = await resolveBenefit(input.quantity);
  const virtualCost = Math.round(config.price * input.quantity * (1 - benefit.discount / 100));
  const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(input.userId);
  if (wallet.balance < virtualCost) throw new Error("No tienes suficientes créditos virtuales para esta participación.");
  const nextBalance = wallet.balance - virtualCost;
  const ticketPublicId = makePublicId("TKT");
  const ticketHash = sha256(canonicalJson({ ticketPublicId, roundPublicId: round.publicId, picks: uniquePicks, quantity: input.quantity, virtualCost, benefit }));
  await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
  await db.insert(pilotTickets).values({
    publicId: ticketPublicId,
    userId: input.userId,
    roundId: round.id,
    gameType: round.gameType,
    picksJson: JSON.stringify(uniquePicks),
    quantity: input.quantity,
    virtualCost,
    benefitTier: benefit.tier,
    status: "confirmed",
    ticketHash,
  });
  await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({
    publicId: makePublicId("WAL"),
    userId: input.userId,
    type: "ticket_debit",
    amount: -virtualCost,
    balanceAfter: nextBalance,
    idempotencyKey: `ticket:${input.idempotencyKey}`,
    description: `Boleto ficticio ${ticketPublicId}`,
    metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ roundPublicId: round.publicId, ticketPublicId, ticketHash, benefit, pilotOnly: true }),
  });
  if (round.gameType === "jackpot") await db.update(gameRounds).set({ jackpotPoolCredits: round.jackpotPoolCredits + Math.round(virtualCost * 0.35) }).where(eq(gameRounds.id, round.id));
  await updateTicketMissions(input.userId);
  const streakBonus = await awardStreakBonus(input.userId, ticketPublicId);
  const finalWallet = await getOrCreateWallet(input.userId);
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: input.userId, eventType: "ticket.confirmed", entityType: "ticket", entityPublicId: ticketPublicId, payload: { roundPublicId: round.publicId, ticketHash, virtualCost, benefit } });
  return { publicId: ticketPublicId, virtualCost, balanceAfter: finalWallet.balance, ticketHash, benefit, streakBonus };
}

export function calculateTicketPrize(gameType: GameType, picks: number[], result: Record<string, unknown>, quantity: number, jackpotShare: number) {
  if (gameType === "ruleta") return picks[0] === result.number ? 360 * quantity : 0;
  if (gameType === "jackpot") {
    const positions = (result.positions as number[]) ?? [];
    const matches = picks.filter((pick) => positions.includes(pick)).length;
    if (matches === 5) return jackpotShare;
    if (matches === 4) return 1200 * quantity;
    if (matches === 3) return 240 * quantity;
    return 0;
  }
  if (gameType === "bingo") return picks[0] === result.winningCartilla ? 450 * quantity : 0;
  if (gameType === "cartas") {
    const cards = (result.cards as number[]) ?? [];
    const matches = picks.filter((pick) => cards.includes(pick)).length;
    if (matches === 3) return 700 * quantity;
    if (matches === 2) return 37 * quantity;
    if (matches === 1) return 5 * quantity;
    return 0;
  }
  const numbers = (result.numbers as number[]) ?? [];
  const matches = picks.filter((pick) => numbers.includes(pick)).length;
  if (matches === 6) return 9000 * quantity;
  if (matches === 5) return 1500 * quantity;
  if (matches === 4) return 250 * quantity;
  if (matches === 3) return 40 * quantity;
  return 0;
}

export async function closeAndDrawRound(actorUserId: number, publicId: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const rows = await db.select().from(gameRounds).where(eq(gameRounds.publicId, publicId)).limit(1);
  const round = rows[0];
  if (!round) throw new Error("No se encontró la ronda.");
  if (!["open", "locked"].includes(round.state)) throw new Error("La ronda no está disponible para cierre y sorteo.");
  const tickets = await db.select().from(pilotTickets).where(and(eq(pilotTickets.roundId, round.id), eq(pilotTickets.status, "confirmed"))).orderBy(pilotTickets.publicId);
  const ticketSetHash = sha256(canonicalJson(tickets.map((ticket) => ({ publicId: ticket.publicId, ticketHash: ticket.ticketHash }))));
  const publicSeed = `PILOT:${round.publicId}:${ticketSetHash.slice(0, 16)}`;
  const result = calculateResult(round.gameType, round.serverSeedSecret, publicSeed, round.publicId);
  const now = new Date();
  const jackpotWinners = round.gameType === "jackpot" ? tickets.filter((ticket) => JSON.parse(ticket.picksJson).filter((pick: number) => (result.positions as number[]).includes(pick)).length === 5) : [];
  const jackpotShare = jackpotWinners.length ? Math.floor(round.jackpotPoolCredits / jackpotWinners.length) : 0;
  for (const ticket of tickets) {
    const prize = calculateTicketPrize(round.gameType, JSON.parse(ticket.picksJson), result, ticket.quantity, jackpotShare);
    await db.update(pilotTickets).set({ status: "settled", virtualPrizeAmount: prize, resultJson: JSON.stringify({ result, prize }) }).where(eq(pilotTickets.id, ticket.id));
    if (prize > 0) {
      const wallet = await getOrCreateWallet(ticket.userId);
      const nextBalance = wallet.balance + prize;
      await db.update(virtualWallets).set({ balance: nextBalance }).where(eq(virtualWallets.id, wallet.id));
      await db.insert(walletTransactions).values({ publicId: makePublicId("WAL"), userId: ticket.userId, type: "virtual_prize", amount: prize, balanceAfter: nextBalance, idempotencyKey: `prize:${ticket.publicId}`, description: `Premio virtual de ${round.publicId}`, metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ roundPublicId: round.publicId, ticketPublicId: ticket.publicId, pilotOnly: true }) });
      await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "ticket.prize_settled", entityType: "ticket", entityPublicId: ticket.publicId, payload: { prize, roundPublicId: round.publicId } });
    }
  }
  await db.update(gameRounds).set({ state: "settled", ticketSetHash, publicSeed, revealedServerSeed: round.serverSeedSecret, resultJson: JSON.stringify(result), lockedAt: round.lockedAt ?? now, drawnAt: now, settledAt: now }).where(eq(gameRounds.id, round.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "round.drawn", entityType: "round", entityPublicId: round.publicId, payload: { ticketSetHash, publicSeed, result, algorithmVersion: ALGORITHM_VERSION } });
  return getRoundProof(round.publicId);
}

export async function getOperationsOverview() {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const rounds = await db.select().from(gameRounds).orderBy(desc(gameRounds.createdAt)).limit(20);
  const tickets = await db.select().from(pilotTickets).orderBy(desc(pilotTickets.createdAt)).limit(50);
  const events = await db.select().from(auditEvents).orderBy(desc(auditEvents.createdAt)).limit(30);
  const promotions = await db.select().from(promotionRules).orderBy(desc(promotionRules.createdAt));
  return { rounds: rounds.map(({ serverSeedSecret: _secret, ...round }) => round), ticketCount: tickets.length, auditEvents: events, marketAuditEvents: events.filter((event) => event.entityType === "market"), promotions, payments: { provider: "yape", enabled: false, countryCode: "PE" } };
}

export async function updatePromotionStatus(actorUserId: number, code: string, isActive: boolean) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const promotion = (await db.select().from(promotionRules).where(eq(promotionRules.code, code)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!promotion) throw new Error("No se encontró la promoción.");
  await db.update(promotionRules).set({ isActive }).where(eq(promotionRules.id, promotion.id));
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "promotion.updated", entityType: "promotion", entityPublicId: code, payload: { isActive } });
  return { code, isActive };
}

export async function publishRulesetRevision(actorUserId: number, gameType: GameType) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const latest = (await db.select().from(gameRulesets).where(eq(gameRulesets.gameType, gameType)).orderBy(desc(gameRulesets.createdAt)).limit(1))[0];
  if (!latest) throw new Error("Primero prepara las reglas iniciales del piloto.");
  const parts = latest.version.replace("v", "").split(".").map(Number);
  const nextVersion = `v${parts[0] ?? 1}.${parts[1] ?? 0}.${(parts[2] ?? 0) + 1}`;
  const rules = { ...JSON.parse(latest.rulesJson), revisionNote: "Revisión publicada desde el panel de operador", publishedAt: new Date().toISOString() };
  await db.insert(gameRulesets).values({ gameType, version: nextVersion, title: latest.title, rulesJson: JSON.stringify(rules), prizePolicyJson: latest.prizePolicyJson, isPublished: true, createdByUserId: actorUserId });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId, eventType: "ruleset.published", entityType: "ruleset", entityPublicId: `${gameType}:${nextVersion}`, payload: { priorVersion: latest.version, nextVersion } });
  return { gameType, version: nextVersion };
}

export async function createDisabledYapeReference(userId: number, virtualAmount: number, idempotencyKey: string) {
  const db = await requireDatabase();
  const existing = await db.select().from(paymentReferences).where(eq(paymentReferences.idempotencyKey, idempotencyKey)).limit(1);
  if (existing[0]) return existing[0];
  const publicId = makePublicId("PAY");
  await db.insert(paymentReferences).values({ publicId, userId, virtualAmount, idempotencyKey, status: "disabled", metadataJson: JSON.stringify({ reason: "Piloto gratuito: integración de pagos desactivada", pilotOnly: true }) });
  await appendAuditEvent({ actorUserId: userId, eventType: "payment_reference.disabled", entityType: "payment_reference", entityPublicId: publicId, payload: { provider: "yape", enabled: false } });
  return { publicId, provider: "yape", status: "disabled" as const };
}

// Preconfigured storage helpers for Manus WebDev templates
// Uploads via Forge Server presigned URL to S3 (PUT direct).
// Downloads return /manus-storage/{key} paths served via 307 redirect.

import { ENV } from "./_core/env";

function getForgeConfig() {
  const forgeUrl = ENV.forgeApiUrl;
  const forgeKey = ENV.forgeApiKey;

  if (!forgeUrl || !forgeKey) {
    throw new Error(
      "Storage config missing: set BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_URL and BUILT_IN_FORGE_API_KEY",
    );
  }

  return { forgeUrl: forgeUrl.replace(/\/+$/, ""), forgeKey };
}

function normalizeKey(relKey: string): string {
  return relKey.replace(/^\/+/, "");
}

function appendHashSuffix(relKey: string): string {
  const hash = crypto.randomUUID().replace(/-/g, "").slice(0, 8);
  const lastDot = relKey.lastIndexOf(".");
  if (lastDot === -1) return `${relKey}_${hash}`;
  return `${relKey.slice(0, lastDot)}_${hash}${relKey.slice(lastDot)}`;
}

export async function storagePut(
  relKey: string,
  data: Buffer | Uint8Array | string,
  contentType = "application/octet-stream",
): Promise<{ key: string; url: string }> {
  const { forgeUrl, forgeKey } = getForgeConfig();
  const key = appendHashSuffix(normalizeKey(relKey));

  // 1. Get presigned PUT URL from Forge
  const presignUrl = new URL("v1/storage/presign/put", forgeUrl + "/");
  presignUrl.searchParams.set("path", key);

  const presignResp = await fetch(presignUrl, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${forgeKey}` },
  });

  if (!presignResp.ok) {
    const msg = await presignResp.text().catch(() => presignResp.statusText);
    throw new Error(`Storage presign failed (${presignResp.status}): ${msg}`);
  }

  const { url: s3Url } = (await presignResp.json()) as { url: string };
  if (!s3Url) throw new Error("Forge returned empty presign URL");

  // 2. PUT file directly to S3
  const blob =
    typeof data === "string"
      ? new Blob([data], { type: contentType })
      : new Blob([data as any], { type: contentType });

  const uploadResp = await fetch(s3Url, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: { "Content-Type": contentType },
    body: blob,
  });

  if (!uploadResp.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Storage upload to S3 failed (${uploadResp.status})`);
  }

  return { key, url: `/manus-storage/${key}` };
}

export async function storageGet(relKey: string): Promise<{ key: string; url: string }> {
  const key = normalizeKey(relKey);
  return { key, url: `/manus-storage/${key}` };
}

export async function storageGetSignedUrl(relKey: string): Promise<string> {
  const { forgeUrl, forgeKey } = getForgeConfig();
  const key = normalizeKey(relKey);

  const getUrl = new URL("v1/storage/presign/get", forgeUrl + "/");
  getUrl.searchParams.set("path", key);

  const resp = await fetch(getUrl, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${forgeKey}` },
  });

  if (!resp.ok) {
    const msg = await resp.text().catch(() => resp.statusText);
    throw new Error(`Storage signed URL failed (${resp.status}): ${msg}`);
  }

  const { url } = (await resp.json()) as { url: string };
  return url;
}

/**
 * Base HTTP error class with status code.
 * Throw this from route handlers to send specific HTTP errors.
 */
export class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public statusCode: number,
    message: string
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "HttpError";
  }
}

// Convenience constructors
export const BadRequestError = (msg: string) => new HttpError(400, msg);
export const UnauthorizedError = (msg: string) => new HttpError(401, msg);
export const ForbiddenError = (msg: string) => new HttpError(403, msg);
export const NotFoundError = (msg: string) => new HttpError(404, msg);

export const COOKIE_NAME = "app_session_id";
export const ONE_YEAR_MS = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365;
export const AXIOS_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
export const UNAUTHED_ERR_MSG = 'Please login (10001)';
export const NOT_ADMIN_ERR_MSG = 'You do not have required permission (10002)';

// One-time nonce cookie that binds an OAuth login to the browser that started
// it. The `__Host-` prefix forces the cookie host-only (Secure, Path=/, no
// Domain), so a sibling *.manus.space site cannot plant a matching value in a
// victim's browser.
export const OAUTH_STATE_COOKIE = "__Host-oauth_state";

// `state` carries the callback redirect URI (used at token exchange) plus the
// CSRF nonce. Defined here so the client encoder and server decoder never drift.
export type OAuthState = { redirectUri: string; nonce?: string };

export const encodeOAuthState = (state: OAuthState): string =>
  btoa(JSON.stringify(state));

export const decodeOAuthState = (state: string): OAuthState => {
  let decoded: string;
  try {
    decoded = atob(state);
  } catch {
    // Malformed base64 (e.g. attacker-supplied garbage). Return no nonce so the
    // callback's CSRF guard rejects it with 403 — never throw, since the caller
    // runs outside the request handler's try/catch.
    return { redirectUri: "" };
  }
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(decoded);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed.redirectUri === "string") return parsed;
  } catch {
    // Legacy links: `state` was a bare base64(redirectUri) with no nonce.
  }
  return { redirectUri: decoded };
};

import { jsxLocPlugin } from "@builder.io/vite-plugin-jsx-loc";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { defineConfig, type Plugin, type ViteDevServer } from "vite";
import { vitePluginManusRuntime } from "vite-plugin-manus-runtime";

// =============================================================================
// Manus Debug Collector - Vite Plugin
// Writes browser logs directly to files, trimmed when exceeding size limit
// =============================================================================

const PROJECT_ROOT = import.meta.dirname;
const LOG_DIR = path.join(PROJECT_ROOT, ".manus-logs");
const MAX_LOG_SIZE_BYTES = 1 * 1024 * 1024; // 1MB per log file
const TRIM_TARGET_BYTES = Math.floor(MAX_LOG_SIZE_BYTES * 0.6); // Trim to 60% to avoid constant re-trimming

type LogSource = "browserConsole" | "networkRequests" | "sessionReplay";

function ensureLogDir() {
  if (!fs.existsSync(LOG_DIR)) {
    fs.mkdirSync(LOG_DIR, { recursive: true });
  }
}

function trimLogFile(logPath: string, maxSize: number) {
  try {
    if (!fs.existsSync(logPath) || fs.statSync(logPath).size <= maxSize) {
      return;
    }

    const lines = fs.readFileSync(logPath, "utf-8").split("\n");
    const keptLines: string[] = [];
    let keptBytes = 0;

    // Keep newest lines (from end) that fit within 60% of maxSize
    const targetSize = TRIM_TARGET_BYTES;
    for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const lineBytes = Buffer.byteLength(`${lines[i]}\n`, "utf-8");
      if (keptBytes + lineBytes > targetSize) break;
      keptLines.unshift(lines[i]);
      keptBytes += lineBytes;
    }

    fs.writeFileSync(logPath, keptLines.join("\n"), "utf-8");
  } catch {
    /* ignore trim errors */
  }
}

function writeToLogFile(source: LogSource, entries: unknown[]) {
  if (entries.length === 0) return;

  ensureLogDir();
  const logPath = path.join(LOG_DIR, `${source}.log`);

  // Format entries with timestamps
  const lines = entries.map((entry) => {
    const ts = new Date().toISOString();
    return `[${ts}] ${JSON.stringify(entry)}`;
  });

  // Append to log file
  fs.appendFileSync(logPath, `${lines.join("\n")}\n`, "utf-8");

  // Trim if exceeds max size
  trimLogFile(logPath, MAX_LOG_SIZE_BYTES);
}

/**
 * Vite plugin to collect browser debug logs
 * - POST /__manus__/logs: Browser sends logs, written directly to files
 * - Files: browserConsole.log, networkRequests.log, sessionReplay.log
 * - Auto-trimmed when exceeding 1MB (keeps newest entries)
 */
function vitePluginManusDebugCollector(): Plugin {
  return {
    name: "manus-debug-collector",

    transformIndexHtml(html) {
      if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "production") {
        return html;
      }
      return {
        html,
        tags: [
          {
            tag: "script",
            attrs: {
              src: "/__manus__/debug-collector.js",
              defer: true,
            },
            injectTo: "head",
          },
        ],
      };
    },

    configureServer(server: ViteDevServer) {
      // POST /__manus__/logs: Browser sends logs (written directly to files)
      server.middlewares.use("/__manus__/logs", (req, res, next) => {
        if (req.method !== "POST") {
          return next();
        }

        const handlePayload = (payload: any) => {
          // Write logs directly to files
          if (payload.consoleLogs?.length > 0) {
            writeToLogFile("browserConsole", payload.consoleLogs);
          }
          if (payload.networkRequests?.length > 0) {
            writeToLogFile("networkRequests", payload.networkRequests);
          }
          if (payload.sessionEvents?.length > 0) {
            writeToLogFile("sessionReplay", payload.sessionEvents);
          }

          res.writeHead(200, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
          res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: true }));
        };

        const reqBody = (req as { body?: unknown }).body;
        if (reqBody && typeof reqBody === "object") {
          try {
            handlePayload(reqBody);
          } catch (e) {
            res.writeHead(400, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: String(e) }));
          }
          return;
        }

        let body = "";
        req.on("data", (chunk) => {
          body += chunk.toString();
        });

        req.on("end", () => {
          try {
            const payload = JSON.parse(body);
            handlePayload(payload);
          } catch (e) {
            res.writeHead(400, { "Content-Type": "application/json" });
            res.end(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: String(e) }));
          }
        });
      });
    },
  };
}

const plugins = [react(), tailwindcss(), jsxLocPlugin(), vitePluginManusRuntime(), vitePluginManusDebugCollector()];

export default defineConfig({
  plugins,

    },
  },
  envDir: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname),
  root: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "client"),
  publicDir: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "client", "public"),
  build: {
    outDir: path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "dist/public"),
    emptyOutDir: true,
  },
  server: {
    host: true,
    allowedHosts: [
      ".manuspre.computer",
      ".manus.computer",
      ".manus-asia.computer",
      ".manuscomputer.ai",
      ".manusvm.computer",
      "localhost",
      "127.0.0.1",
    ],
    fs: {
      strict: true,
      deny: ["**/.*"],
    },
  },
});

## Cover

# Multi Juegos Perú
## Modelo financiero y aporte social verificable
### Escenario tentativo para una futura operación regulada · 24 de agosto de 2026

## Slide 1

# La oportunidad exige dos disciplinas

**Operación sostenible**

- El piloto actual es gratuito: no genera ingresos, utilidad ni aportes monetarios.
- Una versión futura exige autorización, homologación técnica y certificación de plataforma, juegos, progresivos y servicios principales. [1]
- El impacto social debe nacer de utilidad neta verificable, no de promesas comerciales.

**Mensaje de decisión:** diseñar primero el modelo regulado y su economía; comunicar impacto solo cuando existan resultados auditables.

## Slide 2

# La utilidad no es “cada sol jugado”

| Secuencia financiera | Criterio |
|---|---|
| 1. Ingreso Neto de Juego | Apuestas y bonificaciones menos premios y devoluciones. |
| 2. Impuestos y cargos variables | Impuesto específico, pagos, plataforma y soporte. |
| 3. Gastos fijos | Operación, seguridad, IA, cumplimiento, administración y auditoría. |
| 4. Utilidad neta | Solo después del impuesto a la renta. |
| 5. Aporte social | Hasta 1 % de utilidad neta positiva. |

> El aporte social nunca reduce premios, saldos ni depósitos de jugadores.

## Slide 3

# S/ 225 mil mensuales cubren la base operativa

| Bloque de gasto fijo base | S/ mensuales | Peso |
|---|---:|---:|
| Operación, soporte, riesgo y prevención | 64 000 | 28 % |
| Nube, ciberseguridad, IA y sistemas | 41 000 | 18 % |
| Contenido y marketing responsable | 40 000 | 18 % |
| Dirección, administración y finanzas | 46 000 | 20 % |
| Legal, regulación, auditoría y certificación | 34 000 | 15 % |
| **Total fijo mensual** | **225 000** | **100 %** |

**Principio:** reemplazar cada envolvente por cotización, nómina o contrato antes de comprometer gasto.

## Slide 4

# IA: apoyo a control, no sustituto de gobernanza

**Presupuesto base: S/ 14 mil al mes para IA, datos y analítica.**

- Detección de anomalías, fraude y señales de abuso.
- Clasificación de soporte y pronóstico de capacidad operativa.
- Borradores de curaduría con aprobación humana obligatoria.
- No decide sorteos, RTP, premios ni resultados de MultiMarket.

**Control requerido:** trazabilidad, revisión humana, privacidad y pruebas independientes.

## Slide 5

# La escala cambia la utilidad y el impacto

| Escenario mensual | Conservador | Base | Escala |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Ingreso Neto de Juego | S/ 180 000 | S/ 350 000 | S/ 700 000 |
| Utilidad antes de renta | (S/ 51 068) | S/ 64 590 | S/ 319 180 |
| Utilidad neta | (S/ 51 068) | S/ 45 536 | S/ 225 022 |
| Aporte social institucional | S/ 0 | S/ 455 | S/ 2 250 |

**Lectura:** el impacto no debe comprometerse como importe fijo; depende de utilidad neta positiva.

## Slide 6

# El punto de equilibrio está en S/ 271,936

**Caso base mensual**

- Punto de equilibrio estimado de IN: **S/ 271 936**.
- Impuesto específico simplificado: **11,76 % del IN** según la mecánica de 12 % sobre base tras mantenimiento. [2]
- Procesamiento de pagos: 2,5 % del IN; plataforma y soporte variable: 3,0 % del IN. Ambos son supuestos editables.
- Impuesto a la renta: 29,5 % de utilidad gravable positiva en Régimen General. [3]

**Implicación:** primero reservar liquidez, cumplimiento y seguridad; después definir distribución de utilidad.

## Slide 7

# El aporte social debe ser institucional y condicionado

**Regla propuesta**

> Hasta 1 % de utilidad neta después de impuesto a la renta, cuando existan seis meses consecutivos de utilidad positiva, permisos vigentes y cuentas auditadas.

| Salvaguarda | Aplicación |
|---|---|
| Premios | No se descuenta nada automáticamente. |
| Administración | Auditoría y gestión se pagan con presupuesto corporativo. |
| Donaciones de ganadores | Solo opt-in separado y revocable. |
| Transparencia | Reporte trimestral de cálculo, receptor, comprobante y resultado. |

## Slide 8

# Región primero; distrito cuando el fondo sea material

| Etapa | Mecanismo recomendado |
|---|---|
| Fondo inicial | Receptor social existente y calificado; proyectos verificables. |
| Asignación regional | Domicilio verificado voluntariamente, nunca pérdidas o monto apostado. |
| Asignación distrital | Solo si el fondo anual del destino alcanza S/ 15 mil y existe proyecto evaluable. |
| Municipalidades | Proyectos puntuales de escala, con expediente, aceptación y documentación aplicable. [4] |

**Evitar fragmentación:** los montos menores se acumulan en un fondo regional trazable.

## Slide 9

# La entidad de impacto se crea cuando el fondo lo justifique

**Fase 1 — Inicio:** donar mediante entidad existente calificada como perceptora. SUNAT prevé calificación de tres años, RUC y condición tributaria aplicable. [5]

**Fase 2 — Escala:** evaluar una asociación civil independiente si el fondo supera S/ 150 mil anuales durante dos ejercicios consecutivos.

**Controles mínimos:** consejo independiente, cuentas separadas, política de conflictos, auditoría externa, tablero trimestral y selección pública de beneficiarios.

## Slide 10

# El lema debe decir exactamente lo que se puede probar

### No recomendable
**“Tu dinero se queda en tu distrito.”**

Implica una devolución territorial total que no refleja premios, impuestos, costos y reservas.

### Propuesta defendible
**“Multi Juegos Perú — juega con transparencia; hasta 1 % de nuestra utilidad neta elegible apoya proyectos sociales verificables.”**

Cuando exista un año de reportes: **“…con asignación regional publicada, según un reglamento de impacto.”**

## Slide 11

# Las decisiones de los próximos 90 días son claras

1. Encargar dictamen legal, tributario y regulatorio antes de cualquier cobro real.
2. Sustituir envolventes de gasto por tres cotizaciones por partida crítica.
3. Definir política de impacto, umbrales, consejo y formato de reporte público.
4. Identificar tres receptores sociales calificados y un proyecto regional piloto elegible.

**Fuentes:** SUNAT — impuesto de juegos y renta empresarial; Ley N.° 31557; SUNAT y gob.pe sobre donaciones. [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]

## Slide 12

# Transparencia primero. Impacto después.
## Una operación sostenible puede sostener una contribución social medible.
### Multi Juegos Perú · Documento ejecutivo de planeamiento

# Fuentes regulatorias identificadas

- **Decreto Supremo N.° 005-2023-MINCETUR:** página oficial de MINCETUR que aprueba el Reglamento de la Ley N.° 31557 sobre juegos a distancia y apuestas deportivas a distancia. La página enlaza al PDF oficial publicado en El Peruano.
- **URL de norma:** https://www.gob.pe/institucion/mincetur/normas-legales/4743535-005-2023-mincetur
- **PDF oficial:** https://cdn.www.gob.pe/uploads/document/file/5278891/4743535-ds-n-005-publicar-el-peruano.pdf?v=1697229745
- **Pendiente de verificación textual:** artículos sobre porcentaje de retorno al jugador, programas de juego, premios y requisitos de autorización.

La revisión visual del formato oficial de certificado confirma que MINCETUR exige certificación relacionada con plataforma tecnológica, programas/modalidades o componentes de juego y generador de números aleatorios. El resultado de búsqueda oficial asociado indica un RTP inferior mínimo de 85 %, que se contrastará con el texto del formato y la norma antes de usarlo como conclusión.

## Ley N.° 31557 — El Peruano

La ley oficial establece que MINCETUR regula, autoriza, fiscaliza y sanciona los juegos a distancia. Define un sistema progresivo como un programa de juego autorizado y registrado cuyo premio crece según un porcentaje de las apuestas realizadas y las reglas previstas. También dispone que los laboratorios certifican plataformas, programas de juego y porcentajes de retorno, y que las modalidades no pueden afectar la aleatoriedad ni el porcentaje mínimo de retorno al público. La ley, por sí misma, no fija un reparto universal de 70 % para premios y 30 % para la casa; remite las condiciones técnicas al Reglamento y directivas aplicables.

Fuente: https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/dispositivo/NL/2095517-1

## Mercados de predicción

La página oficial de MINCETUR describe un tratamiento normativo integral para juegos a distancia y apuestas deportivas a distancia, con registros separados de plataformas, programas de juego, modalidades y sistemas progresivos. No se localizó en esta revisión una fuente oficial peruana que autorice específicamente un mercado de predicción de usuario a usuario sobre política, economía o sucesos mundiales. Por ello, cualquier MultiMarket debe permanecer como experiencia de créditos virtuales y no habilitar dinero real, retiro, contratos transferibles ni eventos creados libremente por usuarios hasta tener un análisis jurídico y una posición formal de la autoridad competente.

Fuente: https://apuestasdeportivas.mincetur.gob.pe/

## Comunicación de aportes sociales

El artículo 8 del Decreto Legislativo N.° 1044, publicado en El Peruano, prohíbe actos que induzcan a error y señala que el anunciante carga con acreditar la veracidad y exactitud de afirmaciones objetivas. Por ello, una promesa como “1 % de utilidades para obras sociales” solo debe difundirse si se publican el periodo, la fórmula de cálculo, el beneficiario, el comprobante de transferencia y el mecanismo de auditoría. Las deducciones automáticas de premios no se recomiendan: la alternativa adecuada es una donación voluntaria, explícita y revocable por parte del ganador.

Fuente: https://busquedas.elperuano.pe/dispositivo/NL/218542-6

from fractions import Fraction
from math import comb

def pct(value):
    return f"{float(value * 100):.8f}%"

def money(value):
    return f"{float(value):.8f}"

print("RULETA")
ruleta_rtp = Fraction(360, 20) * Fraction(1, 37)
print("prob_exacta", pct(Fraction(1, 37)))
print("rtp", pct(ruleta_rtp))
print("margen", pct(1 - ruleta_rtp))

print("\nJACKPOT")
den = comb(20, 5)
expected_fixed = Fraction(0, 1)
for k, payout in [(5, 0), (4, 1200), (3, 240)]:
    probability = Fraction(comb(5, k) * comb(15, 5-k), den)
    expected_fixed += probability * payout
    print(f"p_{k}", pct(probability))
print("p_0", pct(Fraction(comb(5,0)*comb(15,5),den)))
print("p_1", pct(Fraction(comb(5,1)*comb(15,4),den)))
print("p_2", pct(Fraction(comb(5,2)*comb(15,3),den)))
print("ev_fijo", money(expected_fixed))
print("rtp_sin_pozo", pct(expected_fixed / 45))
print("margen_sin_pozo", pct(1 - expected_fixed / 45))
for n in (100, 1000):
    pool = Fraction(18400, 1) + Fraction(35, 100) * 45 * n
    p_any = 1 - (1 - Fraction(1, den)) ** n
    pool_ev_per_ticket = pool * p_any / n
    total_ev = expected_fixed + pool_ev_per_ticket
    print(f"n_{n}_pozo", money(pool))
    print(f"n_{n}_p_alguien_5", pct(p_any))
    print(f"n_{n}_ev_pozo_por_ticket", money(pool_ev_per_ticket))
    print(f"n_{n}_rtp_total", pct(total_ev / 45))
    print(f"n_{n}_margen_total", pct(1 - total_ev / 45))

print("\nBINGO")
bingo_rtp = Fraction(450, 35) * Fraction(1, 3)
print("p_cartilla", pct(Fraction(1,3)))
print("rtp", pct(bingo_rtp))
print("margen", pct(1-bingo_rtp))

print("\nLOTERIA")
den_lot = comb(49, 6)
expected_lot = Fraction(0, 1)
for k, payout in [(6, 9000), (5, 1500), (4, 250), (3, 40), (2, 0), (1, 0), (0, 0)]:
    probability = Fraction(comb(6,k)*comb(43,6-k), den_lot)
    expected_lot += probability*payout
    print(f"p_{k}", pct(probability))
print("ev", money(expected_lot))
print("rtp", pct(expected_lot/Fraction(25,1)))
print("margen", pct(1-expected_lot/Fraction(25,1)))

print("\nBONOS_LOTERIA_PROPUESTOS")

p_4_plus_bonus = Fraction(comb(6,4)*comb(43,2), den_lot) * Fraction(2,43)
p_no_prize = sum(Fraction(comb(6,k)*comb(43,6-k), den_lot) for k in (0,1,2))
safe_ball_rtp = p_no_prize * Fraction(2,25)
monthly_pool_rtp = p_no_prize * Fraction(2,100)
new_lottery_ev = (Fraction(750,1)*Fraction(comb(6,3)*comb(43,3),den_lot) + Fraction(4500,1)*Fraction(comb(6,4)*comb(43,2),den_lot) + Fraction(28000,1)*Fraction(comb(6,5)*comb(43,1),den_lot) + Fraction(170000,1)*Fraction(comb(6,6)*comb(43,0),den_lot))
print("p_5_mas_bola_extra", pct(p_5_plus_bonus))
print("p_4_mas_bola_extra", pct(p_4_plus_bonus))
print("p_sin_premio_principal", pct(p_no_prize))
print("rtp_bola_segura_2cr", pct(safe_ball_rtp))
print("rtp_pozo_mensual_2pct_solo_perdedores", pct(monthly_pool_rtp))

print("rtp_total_loteria_propuesto", pct(new_lottery_ev/Fraction(25,1)+safe_ball_rtp+monthly_pool_rtp))
print("margen_total_loteria_propuesto", pct(1-(new_lottery_ev/Fraction(25,1)+safe_ball_rtp+monthly_pool_rtp)))

    pool_rtp = Fraction(5,100) * (1-Fraction(1,n))

print("\nJACKPOT_TABLEROS_PROPUESTOS")
for side in range(3, 8):
    cells = side * side
    picks = side
    total = comb(cells, picks)
    print(f"tablero_{side}x{side}", "celdas", cells, "seleccion", picks, "odds_jackpot", f"1/{total}", "p_jackpot", pct(Fraction(1,total)))
    for matches in range(picks, max(picks - 3, 0), -1):
        p = Fraction(comb(picks,matches)*comb(cells-picks,picks-matches),total)
        print(f"  match_{matches}", pct(p))

print("\nTABLAS_JACKPOT_RTP_PROPUESTAS")
paytables = {
    3: {3: 90, 2: 29, 1: 1},
    4: {4: 2000, 3: 50, 2: 25},
    5: {5: 30000, 4: 1200, 3: 140},
    6: {6: 900000, 5: 6000, 4: 2030},
    7: {7: 4000000, 6: 300000, 5: 32000},
}
for side, payouts in paytables.items():
    cells = side * side
    picks = side
    total = comb(cells, picks)
    ev = sum(Fraction(comb(picks,matches)*comb(cells-picks,picks-matches), total) * payout for matches,payout in payouts.items())
    base_rtp = ev / 10
    total_rtp = base_rtp + Fraction(7,100) + Fraction(1,100)
    print(f"{side}x{side}", "pagos", payouts, "ev", money(ev), "rtp_base", pct(base_rtp), "rtp_con_pozo7_y_bonos1", pct(total_rtp), "margen", pct(1-total_rtp))

from fractions import Fraction
from math import comb

def pct(value):
    return f"{float(value * 100):.8f}%"

den = comb(13, 3)
p3 = Fraction(comb(3, 3) * comb(10, 0), den)
p2 = Fraction(comb(3, 2) * comb(10, 1), den)
p1 = Fraction(comb(3, 1) * comb(10, 2), den)
p0 = Fraction(comb(3, 0) * comb(10, 3), den)

paytable = {3: 700, 2: 35, 1: 4}
expected = p3 * paytable[3] + p2 * paytable[2] + p1 * paytable[1]
ticket = Fraction(10, 1)

print("TRIO_13")
for matches, probability in [(3, p3), (2, p2), (1, p1), (0, p0)]:
    print(f"p_{matches}", pct(probability))
print("ev_creditos", f"{float(expected):.8f}")
print("rtp", pct(expected / ticket))
print("margen", pct(1 - expected / ticket))

print("MERCADO_VIRTUAL_SI_NO")
print("contrato_si_gana", "100 creditos virtuales si ocurre; 0 si no ocurre")
print("precio_60", "60 creditos por contrato; valor implicito 60% antes de comision")
print("comision_liquidacion", "2% solo sobre ganancia virtual positiva; 0 en piloto")

def setup_sheet(sheet, title, subtitle, unit='(S/ salvo indicación contraria)'):
    sheet.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
    sheet.column_dimensions['A'].width = 20
    sheet.column_dimensions['B'].width = 20
    sheet.merge_cells('C3:G3')
    title_cell = sheet['C3']
    title_cell.value = title
    title_cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=DARK_GREEN)
    title_cell.font = Font(color=WHITE, bold=True, size=16)
    title_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='left')
    sheet['C5'] = subtitle
    sheet['C5'].font = Font(bold=True, size=11)
    sheet['C6'] = unit
    sheet['C6'].font = Font(italic=True, color='666666')
    sheet.page_setup.orientation = 'landscape'
    sheet.page_setup.fitToWidth = 1
    sheet.page_setup.fitToHeight = 0
    sheet.print_area = 'B2:K60'
    sheet.oddFooter.center.text = f'{sheet.title} | Página &P'

def section(sheet, row, label, end_col='G'):
    sheet.merge_cells(start_row=row, start_column=3, end_row=row, end_column=ord(end_col)-64)
    cell = sheet.cell(row=row, column=3)
    cell.value = label
    cell.fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor=LIGHT_GREEN)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color=BLACK)

def hardcoded(cell, value, comment_text, fmt=None):
    cell.value = value
    cell.font = Font(color=BLUE)
    cell.comment = Comment(comment_text, 'Manus AI')
    if fmt:
        cell.number_format = fmt

def formula(cell, value, fmt=None, linked=False):
    cell.value = value
    cell.font = Font(color=GREEN if linked else BLACK)
    if fmt:
        cell.number_format = fmt

def finalize(sheet):
    for col in range(3, sheet.max_column + 1):
        width = 12
        for row in range(1, sheet.max_row + 1):
            value = sheet.cell(row=row, column=col).value
            if value is not None:
                width = max(width, min(48, len(str(value)) + 2))
        sheet.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(col)].width = width

    sources.cell(r, 3, f'{r-16}.')
    sources.cell(r, 4, text)
    sources.merge_cells(start_row=r, start_column=4, end_row=r, end_column=6)

for sheet in wb.worksheets:
    finalize(sheet)
    for row in sheet.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical='top', wrap_text=True)

wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
wb.save(OUTPUT_FILE)
print(OUTPUT_FILE)

from pathlib import Path
from openpyxl import load_workbook

path = Path('/home/ubuntu/financial_deliverables/modelo_tentativo_multi_juegos_peru.xlsx')
wb = load_workbook(path, data_only=False)

required_sheets = {'Supuestos', 'Presupuesto Base', 'Escenarios', 'Impacto Territorial', 'Fuentes y límites'}
assert required_sheets.issubset(set(wb.sheetnames)), f'Hojas faltantes: {required_sheets - set(wb.sheetnames)}'

assumptions = wb['Supuestos']
assert assumptions['E10'].value == 350000
assert assumptions['E11'].value == 225000
assert assumptions['D15'].value == 0.1176
assert assumptions['D18'].value == 0.295
assert assumptions['D19'].value == 0.01

budget = wb['Presupuesto Base']
assert budget['D18'].value == '=SUM(D10:D17)'
assert budget['D27'].value == '=SUM(D22:D26)'
assert budget['D29'].value == '=D18+D27'

scenarios = wb['Escenarios']
assert scenarios['E16'].value == '=E14+E15'
assert scenarios['E17'].value == '=-MAX(0,E16*Supuestos!$D$19)'
assert scenarios['D23'].value == '=Supuestos!E11/D22'

impact = wb['Impacto Territorial']
assert impact['D10'].value == '=ABS(Escenarios!D17)'
assert impact['D12'].value == '=IF(D11>=Supuestos!$D$20,"Sí","No; acumular a fondo regional")'

source_comments = [assumptions['D15'].comment, assumptions['D18'].comment, assumptions['D19'].comment]
assert all(comment is not None for comment in source_comments), 'Faltan comentarios de trazabilidad en inputs.'

# Reproduce los resultados base mostrados en el informe para verificar las fórmulas.
income = 350000
game_tax = income * 0.1176
payment = income * 0.025
variable_support = income * 0.03
fixed_cost = 225000
pre_tax = income - game_tax - payment - variable_support - fixed_cost
income_tax = max(0, pre_tax * 0.295)
net_income = pre_tax - income_tax
social = max(0, net_income * 0.01)
breakeven = fixed_cost / (1 - 0.1176 - 0.025 - 0.03)

assert round(pre_tax, 2) == 64590.00
assert round(income_tax, 2) == 19054.05
assert round(net_income, 2) == 45535.95
assert round(social, 2) == 455.36
assert round(breakeven, 2) == 271936.19

print('Modelo validado')
print(f'Utilidad neta base: S/ {net_income:,.2f}')
print(f'Aporte social base: S/ {social:,.2f}')
print(f'Punto de equilibrio: S/ {breakeven:,.2f}')

# Paquete de auditoría — Multi Juegos Perú

Este paquete contiene el código fuente, migraciones, pruebas, documentación funcional y regulatoria, modelo financiero editable y fuente HTML de la presentación ejecutiva disponibles al 24 de agosto de 2026.

## Alcance incluido

5. Revisar supuestos azules, fórmulas y notas de fuente del archivo financiero antes de adoptar cualquier presupuesto.

> El proyecto permanece en piloto gratuito. No se debe activar dinero real, pagos, retiros, pronósticos sensibles ni mensajes de aporte social sin autorización, certificación y revisión profesional aplicables.

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_ROOT = Path('/home/ubuntu/ruleta-peru-online')
DELIVERABLES = Path('/home/ubuntu/financial_deliverables')
OUTPUT = DELIVERABLES / 'auditoria_consolidada_multi_juegos_peru_2026-08-24.txt'

EXCLUDED_DIRS = {'.git', 'node_modules', '.manus', '.manus-logs', 'dist', 'build', '__pycache__'}
TEXT_EXTENSIONS = {
    '.css', '.csv', '.html', '.js', '.json', '.md', '.mjs', '.py', '.sh', '.sql',
    '.toml', '.ts', '.tsx', '.txt', '.xml', '.yaml', '.yml', '.lock', '.gitignore',
    '.prettierignore', '.prettierrc', '.npmrc', '.eslintrc', '.env.example',
}


def sha256(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def is_excluded(path: Path) -> bool:
    relative_parts = path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT).parts
    if any(part in EXCLUDED_DIRS for part in relative_parts):
        return True
    name = path.name
    return name == '.env' or name.startswith('.env.')


def is_text_file(path: Path, data: bytes) -> bool:
    if path.suffix.lower() in TEXT_EXTENSIONS or path.name in TEXT_EXTENSIONS:
        return True
    try:
        data.decode('utf-8')
        return True
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return False


def project_entries() -> list[tuple[str, Path]]:
    entries: list[tuple[str, Path]] = []
    for path in sorted(PROJECT_ROOT.rglob('*')):
        if not path.is_file() or is_excluded(path):
            continue
        entries.append((f'proyecto/{path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT).as_posix()}', path))
    return entries


def external_entries() -> list[tuple[str, Path]]:
    selected: list[tuple[str, Path]] = [
        ('entregables/modelo_tentativo_multi_juegos_peru.xlsx', DELIVERABLES / 'modelo_tentativo_multi_juegos_peru.xlsx'),
        ('entregables/presentacion_ejecutiva_multi_juegos_peru.md', DELIVERABLES / 'presentacion_ejecutiva_multi_juegos_peru.md'),
        ('analisis/regulatory_findings.md', Path('/home/ubuntu/regulatory_findings.md')),
        ('analisis/calcular_probabilidades_piloto.py', Path('/home/ubuntu/calcular_probabilidades_piloto.py')),
        ('analisis/calcular_cartas_y_mercados.py', Path('/home/ubuntu/calcular_cartas_y_mercados.py')),
        ('analisis/create_multi_juegos_financial_model.py', Path('/home/ubuntu/create_multi_juegos_financial_model.py')),
        ('analisis/validate_multi_juegos_financial_model.py', Path('/home/ubuntu/validate_multi_juegos_financial_model.py')),
        ('analisis/create_audit_package.sh', Path('/home/ubuntu/create_audit_package.sh')),
        ('analisis/create_single_audit_file.py', Path('/home/ubuntu/create_single_audit_file.py')),
    ]
    for presentation_source in sorted(DELIVERABLES.glob('multi-juegos-ejecutivo-*')):
        if presentation_source.is_dir():
            for path in sorted(presentation_source.rglob('*')):
                if path.is_file():
                    selected.append((f'entregables/fuente_presentacion/{path.relative_to(presentation_source).as_posix()}', path))
    return [(label, path) for label, path in selected if path.exists() and path.is_file()]


def write_separator(handle, label: str, payload: bytes, kind: str) -> None:
    handle.write('\n' + '=' * 100 + '\n')
    handle.write(f'ARCHIVO: {label}\n')
    handle.write(f'TIPO: {kind}\n')
    handle.write(f'TAMANIO_BYTES: {len(payload)}\n')
    handle.write(f'SHA256: {sha256(payload)}\n')
    handle.write('=' * 100 + '\n')


def main() -> None:
    entries = project_entries() + external_entries()
    seen: set[str] = set()
    unique_entries = []
    for label, path in entries:
        if label not in seen:
            unique_entries.append((label, path))
            seen.add(label)

    with OUTPUT.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as handle:
        handle.write('# AUDITORIA CONSOLIDADA — MULTI JUEGOS PERU\n')
        handle.write('# Fecha de generación: 2026-08-24\n')
        handle.write('# Formato: cada archivo está separado por ruta, tipo, tamaño y SHA-256.\n')
        handle.write('# Texto: contenido UTF-8 legible. Binario: codificación Base64 para preservación.\n')
        handle.write('# Exclusiones de seguridad: dependencias instaladas, historial Git, registros temporales y archivos de entorno.\n')
        handle.write('# No se incluye el XLSM legado por contener macros y potenciales datos personales; se mantiene como insumo original separado.\n')
        handle.write(f'# Archivos consolidados: {len(unique_entries)}\n')

        for label, path in unique_entries:
            payload = path.read_bytes()
            if is_text_file(path, payload):
                write_separator(handle, label, payload, 'TEXTO_UTF8')
                handle.write(payload.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
                if not payload.endswith(b'\n'):
                    handle.write('\n')
            else:
                write_separator(handle, label, payload, 'BINARIO_BASE64')
                handle.write(base64.b64encode(payload).decode('ascii'))
                handle.write('\n')

        handle.write('\n' + '=' * 100 + '\n')
        handle.write('FIN DE AUDITORIA CONSOLIDADA\n')
        handle.write('=' * 100 + '\n')

    print(OUTPUT)
    print(f'Archivos incorporados: {len(unique_entries)}')
    print(f'SHA256 del consolidado: {sha256(OUTPUT.read_bytes())}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

def write_entry(handle, label: str, path: Path) -> None:
    payload = path.read_bytes()
    kind = 'TEXTO_UTF8' if is_text(path, payload) else 'BINARIO_BASE64'
    handle.write('\n' + '=' * 100 + '\n')
    handle.write(f'ARCHIVO: {label}\nTIPO: {kind}\nTAMANIO_BYTES: {len(payload)}\nSHA256: {file_hash(payload)}\n')
    handle.write('=' * 100 + '\n')
    if kind == 'TEXTO_UTF8':
        handle.write(payload.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
        if not payload.endswith(b'\n'):
            handle.write('\n')
    else:
        handle.write(base64.b64encode(payload).decode('ascii') + '\n')


def main() -> None:
    unique: dict[str, Path] = {}
    for label, path in source_entries():
        unique.setdefault(label, path)

    with OUTPUT.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as handle:
        handle.write(EXECUTIVE_AUDIT)
        handle.write(f'ARCHIVOS CONSOLIDADOS: {len(unique)}\n')
        for label, path in unique.items():
            write_entry(handle, label, path)
        handle.write('\n' + '=' * 100 + '\nFIN DE AUDITORÍA ACTUALIZADA\n' + '=' * 100 + '\n')

    payload = OUTPUT.read_bytes()
    print(OUTPUT)
    print(f'Archivos incorporados: {len(unique)}')
    print(f'SHA256 del documento: {file_hash(payload)}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

        <div class="number">02</div>
        <h2>Fondo regional</h2>

      <article class="stage accent">
        <div class="number">03</div>
        <h2>Destino distrital</h2>

      </article>
    </section>

      <div class="rule-item"><div class="rule-label">Criterio territorial</div><p class="rule-copy">Domicilio verificado y voluntario del jugador adulto.</p></div>
      <div class="rule-item"><div class="rule-label">Criterio prohibido</div><p class="rule-copy">Nunca usar apuestas, pérdidas o premios como factor de asignación.</p></div>
      <div class="rule-item"><div class="rule-label">Municipalidades</div><p class="rule-copy">Solo para proyectos puntuales de escala, con expediente y aceptación formal aplicable.</p></div>
    </aside>
